Game Overview

Flappy Wings puts players into a animal experience centered on guide a delightful bird through daring obstacles in Flappy Wings. Master timing and precision to keep your bird airborne in this exhilarating arcade challenge. Tap to soar and navigate tight spaces, but beware—quick reflexes and steady nerves are your best allies in this addictive high-score pursuit.
